result.rationale: The server's save_host assigns `host.category_id = SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id if host.category_id.blank?`, but the component's save action does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))))` where categoryId was never updated from the server response and remains null when nothing was selected, so findById(null) yields no category and the row displays blank until reload. The described mechanism is consistent with the diff.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, in embeddable-host.js.es6 line 36-37, after saving, it calls `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`. The categoryId is set from `this.get('host.category.id')` in the edit action (line 25-26). For a new host where no category was selected, categoryId would be null. The server-side code in embeddable_hosts_controller.rb lines 23-24 sets `host.category_id = SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id if host.category_id.blank?`, so the server stores uncategorized, but the client still has null categoryId and calls findById(null), which would return undefined/null, causing a blank category display until reload.
